title: Gym messages may stay silent on OPPO and OnePlus phones
what: The rescue ring for gym messages tells the check the channel was made at normal importance, but it was made at high. When the phone strips the sound and marks it as set, the check takes it for the member's own choice and does not ring. The rest-over alert passes high and rings.
expected: The gym-message ring passes the importance the channel was really made with (high), like the rest-over ring.
who: members on OPPO and OnePlus phones
how_often: every gym message, on phones that mark the stripped sound as set
fix_line: Tell the check that the gym-message channel was made at high importance
